230: We do not climb a tree, ride on an animal, swim in water, slap the hand on the thigh, clap hands, dance, make legal judgmenets, get engaged, get married, divorce, perform a levirate marriage, do halitzah, make a herem vow, or separate trumah or tithes. Rem"a: Regarding redeeming the first born, the rule on a holiday is the same as the rule on Shabbat. See above in chapter 339 paragraph 4.
One who is dangerously ill and will leave the world soon is permitted to divorce, even on Shabbat.
